question: Did bounded public GBIF searches or web discovery identify any site-resolved fish evidence for Silongin River, San Francisco, Quezon?
purpose: Screen an officially named Quezon river for indexed occurrence and published fish-survey leads without converting a zero-result search into an absence claim.

gbif.queryTaxonomy: Catalogue of Life Extended Release Actinopterygii
gbif.resultHandling: No rows were available to review. The API searches GBIF-indexed metadata only; non-retrieval does not show that fish are absent or that no survey exists.

queryPhrases: Quezon fish survey "San Francisco" Silongin river
webSearch.result: No station-resolved fish survey or fish occurrence source for Silongin River was identified in the bounded public-web search.

findings.evidence: The GBIF occurrence API returned zero rows for both the indexed locality term “Silongin” and waterBody term “Silongin River,” filtered to Philippines and CoL XR Actinopterygii.
supports: only that these two bounded indexed queries returned zero on 2026-11-02
doesNotSupport: records outside GBIF or with different verbatim locality

findings.evidence: The EMB report names Silongin River at municipality-level but is a historical water-classification table, not fish sampling.
The provincial directory confirms a barangay named Silongin in San Francisco, but does not provide fish records.

excludedSearchFindings.title: Fish Sanctuary Conservation Program: Potential and Challenges (MSEUF, 2023)
excludedSearchFindings.reason: The abstract concerns evaluation of the Celebes Maru Sanctuary in San Francisco and an online resident survey; it does not report biological fish sampling or link to Silongin River.

nextActions: Keep the fish-evidence status as unknown; do not label Silongin fishless from zero API results.
Search authorized BFAR IV-A, Quezon LGU, EMB, and university repositories for dated sampling tables, stations, identification methods, vouchers, and reuse terms.
Continue the name and route work for Silongin Lagda and Kanguinsa as separate tasks; do not transfer any future records across names without locality/station crosswalk.
nonClaims: This was a bounded discovery screen, not an exhaustive literature or museum-catalog search.
No GBIF data row, scientific-name assertion, current presence/absence, diet, salinity, water quality, safety, access, or fishing rule was established.
